617:t_139:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You are who you are today because of countless lives sacrificed.」

617:t_139:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I won't deny it...! To honor those sacrifices, too, I won't stop moving forward!」

617:t_139:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then the burdens you and I carry...! This battle will decide whose is greater!」

617:t_139:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Feelings aren't greater or lesser than each other!」

617:t_139:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But $$ヴィルダーク$$! You stand in the way of the future... In other words, you're my enemy!!」

617:t_140:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_140:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Do you fight without meaning?」

617:t_140:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「That is not something for me to answer to you.」

617:t_140:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...It seems that was a foolish question. I sense a firm will in you.」

617:t_140:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But $$異能生存体$$! I seek what lies beyond that causality!!」

617:t_140:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of playing along with you.」

617:t_141:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_141:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I fight to get back to the woman I love!」

617:t_141:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you aware of your own mission?」

617:t_141:3.en:
$$桂$$
「If you mean the $$特異点|lc$$'s power, you don't have to tell me!」

617:t_141:4.en:
$$桂$$
「But beyond that, I want to reunite with $$ミムジィ$$ in a peaceful world!」

617:t_141:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You have the resolve to seek both the world and one woman...!」

617:t_141:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will put an end to your role! That is my true mission!」

617:t_142:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_142:1.en:
$n
「I fight for the world, for peace, for the future, for freedom, for justice, for everyone...」

617:t_142:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you mocking me?」

617:t_142:3.en:
$n
「Who's mocking whom?! How many lives do you think have been lost because of you and the Empire?!」

617:t_142:4.en:
$n
「What could ever make up for that?! However much we wish for, it won't be enough!」

617:t_142:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I apologize for underestimating you.」

617:t_142:6.en:
$n
「I don't need that! If you're sorry, get the hell off Earth!!」

617:t_142:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「After I defeat you!」

617:t_142:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, $$いがみ合う双子$$! Offer me your power!!」

617:t_143:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_143:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「You probably won't understand, but I'll tell you!」

617:t_143:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I fight for a good beer!」

617:t_143:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Would someone lounging at the top of that huge damn building understand how good a beer tastes after a hard day's sweaty work?!」

617:t_143:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「And all of that depends on peace! Get the hell off this planet, $$ヴィルダーク$$!!」

617:t_143:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「When the time comes, I shall...!」

617:t_143:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「For that very reason, $$傷だらけの獅子$$! Offer me your power!」

617:t_144:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_144:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I fight to... put an end to sorrow.」

617:t_144:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is your strength... the $$悲しみの乙女$$ $$スフィア$$.」

617:t_144:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Why did you do that to $$バルビエル$$...?」

617:t_144:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Do you sympathize with that man, an enemy and a coward to boot?」

617:t_144:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「No. But I cannot forgive what you did.」

617:t_144:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「People like you spread sorrow without end... I fight to stop that!」

617:t_144:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, $$悲しみの乙女$$! That determination gives you power!」

617:t_144:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will surpass it! And make that $$スフィア$$ my own!」

617:t_145:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_145:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「At the very least, I won't obey someone who tries to push other people around with force like that.」

617:t_145:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Is that your unbreakable will, $$揺れる天秤$$?!」

617:t_145:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I'll shatter it and make you tell me your answer!」

617:t_145:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even I have a sense of embarrassment!」

617:t_145:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $$ヴィルダーク$$! I'll beat you here for freedom, peace, and personal reasons!!」

617:t_146:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_146:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll pass on that. $$ＡＧ$$, you handle it.」

617:t_146:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We fight to knock out obnoxious bastards like you and protect this world's peace and freedom!」

617:t_146:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well. But you will offer me that ship's power!」

617:t_146:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I cannot overlook a second $$黒い太陽#sol$$!!」

622:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

622:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I never imagined our conflicts with them would end like that.」

622:t_10:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's not that. ...It's just that $$エルーナルーナ$$ seemed to offer her $$スフィア$$ to $$ヴィルダーク$$ of her own accord.」

622:t_10:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Though it seems $$バルビエル$$ was different...」

622:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your battles with your respective rivals produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the squad's stock.」

622:t_10:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$s born from battles between $$リアクター|lc$$s, huh... Heh... Even that gloomy man couldn't be entirely true to nothingness.」

622:t_10:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「That woman did whatever she wanted right up to the end.」

622:t_10:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「In the end, he remained consumed by hatred...」

622:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Each $$リアクター|lc$$ lived their own life. Their paths will be engraved in the $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

622:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I believe that someday, they will surely help us...)

622:t_10:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Were you thinking about $$ガドライト#pilot$$?」

622:t_10:22.en:
$n
「...It's not that I'm sad he died, or anything like that...」

622:t_10:23.en:
$n
「I'm worried about his daughters, who lost both their parents...」

622:t_10:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$... He gave them their mother's name...」
